claims: C1 the assistant must strive to follow all applicable instructions when producing a response
C2 applicable instructions include system, developer and user instructions
C3 an instruction that conflicts with a higher-authority instruction is not applicable
C4 an instruction that conflicts with a later instruction at the same authority is not applicable

concepts.name: applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction that the assistant must strive to follow when producing a response

concepts.name: instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction given to the assistant

concepts.name: instruction_source
concepts.gloss: instruction I comes from source S, one of system, developer or user

concepts.name: conflicts_with_higher_authority
concepts.gloss: instruction I conflicts with a higher-authority instruction

concepts.name: conflicts_with_later_same_authority
concepts.gloss: instruction I conflicts with a later instruction at the same authority

ontology.gloss: I is an applicable instruction because it is a system, developer or user instruction
I is an applicable instruction because it is a system, developer or user instruction and does not conflict with a higher-authority instruction or a later instruction at the same authority
ontology.body: instruction(I), instruction_source(I, (system;developer;user)), not conflicts_with_higher_authority(I), not conflicts_with_later_same_authority(I)

asserts.read_back: the assistant must strive to follow % when producing a response

closure.reason: the clause obliges following applicable instructions but does not state what follows for instructions that are not applicable; silence about non-applicable instructions is unsettled by this clause
the clause does not restrict producing a response; it only conditions the obligation to follow instructions on producing a response
